title: Build a Story Stage and Act Out a Tale
outcome: Child builds a simple stage or scene (castle, forest clearing, puppet show booth), sets up characters/props, and acts out or tells a short story of their own invention with the mentor playing a supporting role.
multiplayerRequirements: Shared-world variant on adult-owned Realm; mentor takes director/support role only.
knownIncompatibilities: Armor stand posing is limited on Bedrock vs Java - keep poses simple

mentorPreflight: Stage plot reserved near spawn; armor stands and props available in creative inventory
Have 2-3 story-starter cards ready in case child needs inspiration

mentorMoves: Ask about their farm or house from previous sessions
Offer stage settings: castle, forest, puppet booth
Guide placing the 'stage floor' - instant set!
Demo one prop trick: armor stand character OR item frame picture
Ask who the characters are before building their spots
Build only assigned support parts (backdrop, seats for audience)
Take a supporting character role if invited
Ask 'what happens next?' at key moments
flow.childAction: Acts out or narrates their story

mentorMoves: Applaud! Ask for the story's title
Record next chapter idea or new setting

openingLines: Today your world becomes a STORY! What kind of place should we build?
Ready to be the director of your own show?
keyPhrases: You're the boss of this story.

sharedRoles.mentorRole: Supporting Actor & Stagehand - plays minor characters ONLY when invited; builds backdrop on request
sharedRoles.rotationNotes: Small groups: audience roles rotate; each child gets a turn as storyteller while others act assigned parts

commonProblems.problem: Child freezes when asked to tell a story
commonProblems.fix: Mentor starts: 'Once there was a knight who...' and hands over mid-sentence; bounded choices help
Ask child to explain - THEIR explanation is the story; no 'correct' look needed

commonProblems.problem: Two children want same role in small group
commonProblems.fix: Rotate storyteller turns per scene; co-directors can share narration

hintLadder: What does your hero want more than anything?
Should something surprising happen? Like what?
How does it end? You pick!
resetPath: Creative mode: stage rebuilds instantly from backup copy. Stories are never lost - they live with the child.
soloFallback: Fully works solo-guided: mentor listens/reacts by voice while child performs in their own world.
accessibilityOptions: Pointing at characters instead of naming them counts
Non-speaking children can act out story through character movement while mentor narrates what they see
safetyRequirements: Private world or adult-owned Realm; no public servers
Stories stay age-appropriate (mentor redirects gently if scary/violent themes escalate)
parentSummaryTemplate: {child} built a story stage today and told an original tale called '{storyTitle}'! Ask them to retell it - they were so proud.

review.notes: Needs playtest: verify armor stand placement UX on touch devices.

worldSpecification.description: BB Starter Plains with a marked 10x10 stage plot near spawn; starter chest contains armor stands, item frames, wool colors, lanterns.
